title: spec review: C-O5 v2: executor image and host runbook — Dockerfile, compose, runbook, protected creds paths (spec round 2 after T-0162; supersedes T-0117)
spec:
Why: the executor runs on kenta-server (Ubuntu 20.04, Docker) in its own container so Claude Code, Codex, uv, git and gh get a current userland and the credentials live in mounted host files. Round 2 folds in spec review T-0162 (UID/GID alignment, version pins, objective secret check, protected credential paths); dispatched without a further spec review by Planner decision.

Dockerfile: FROM ubuntu:24.04; ARG UID=1000 ARG GID=1000 create group/user `orch` with those ids (HOME=/home/orch) so bind-mounted credential dirs created on the host with the same ids are writable; install ca-certificates, curl, git, gh (GitHub CLI apt repo), python3; uv via the official installer pinned with `ARG UV_VERSION` (installer supports a version); Claude Code via the native installer documented at code.claude.com/docs/en/setup (not npm) pinned with `ARG CLAUDE_VERSION` if the installer accepts a version argument, otherwise record the installed version in the build log with `claude --version` and note in a comment that the native installer only ships latest; Codex CLI from the openai/codex GitHub release for linux x86_64 pinned with `ARG CODEX_VERSION` (comment on how to bump; `codex --version` in the build); copy this repo to /opt/orchestrator, chown to orch, `uv sync --frozen`; USER orch; entrypoint `uv run orchestrator serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8090`.
docker-compose.executor.yml: service `orchestrator-executor`, build with args UID/GID from env (default 1000), volumes ./work:/work, ${ORCH_CREDS}/claude-a:/home/orch/.claude-a, ${ORCH_CREDS}/claude-b:/home/orch/.claude-b, ${ORCH_CREDS}/codex:/home/orch/.codex, ${ORCH_CREDS}/gh:/home/orch/.config/gh; env_file ./executor.env (gitignored; holds ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN, CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN_A, CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN_B, ORCH_NOTIFY_URL, GH_READ_TOKEN); healthcheck curl -f http://localhost:8090/healthz; restart unless-stopped; no published ports (reached on the home docker network by the kgpt module).
.dockerignore: wt/, .venv/, .orchestrator/runs, .orchestrator/bus.sqlite*, graphify-out/, executor.env.
.orchestrator/protected-paths.txt: add the executor credential mount roots so guardrails.sh blocks them: `${ORCH_CREDS}`, `/home/orch/.claude-a`, `/home/orch/.claude-b`, `/home/orch/.codex`, `/home/orch/.config/gh` (follow the file's existing line format; look at how guardrails.sh reads it).
docs/executor-host.md runbook for the human: prerequisites; `id -u`/`id -g` on the host and export UID/GID for the build; create the creds dirs on the host owned by that uid; on the laptop run `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-a claude setup-token` and the same for b, paste each token into executor.env (never into git); `docker compose -f docker-compose.executor.yml run --rm orchestrator-executor codex login --device-auth` once so auth.json lands in the mounted volume; `gh auth login` likewise; pool.toml on the host: oauth_token_env = "CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN_A" / "_B" (C-O2a) and role secrets in env: form; repos.toml entry for kgpt; smoke test with curl against /healthz and a POST /goals on a scratch repo (using the bearer from executor.env, shown as `$ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN`, never a literal); how to rotate a token; what to check when a goal does not start (planner log path under <repo>/.orchestrator/runs/). Every secret in the doc appears only as an env var name or the placeholder `<paste here>`. Add executor.env to .gitignore. README.md: link the runbook from "Use on a project".
Acceptance check for secrets (objective): `git diff <base> HEAD | grep -E '(TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)[A-Z_]*\s*[=:]\s*[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{12,}'` returns nothing. Tests: `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` still green; no test_install change required. Finish with: summary, files changed, image size, the four version lines, failures-only test output; commit on the task branch when green.
acceptance: `docker build --build-arg UID=$(id -u) --build-arg GID=$(id -g) .` succeeds locally (record the image size) and `docker run --rm <image> sh -c 'claude --version && codex --version && uv --version && gh --version'` prints four versions; the container runs as orch with the build-arg uid

docker-compose.executor.yml validates with `docker compose -f docker-compose.executor.yml config` given a dummy executor.env, publishes no ports, and mounts exactly the four credential dirs plus ./work
docs/executor-host.md contains every human step incl. UID/GID alignment; the objective grep for secret-like assignments over the diff returns nothing; executor.env is in .gitignore and .dockerignore
.orchestrator/protected-paths.txt lists the five credential mount paths in the file's format
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency; only the seven scoped files change; committed on the task branch
